name: Ichinose
blurb: Central hub — most rental shops, restaurants, and lifts radiate from here.

name: Yakebitaiyama
blurb: Base One — Shiga Kogen Prince & Olympic hotels, true ski-in ski-out.

name: Okushiga Kogen
blurb: Furthest north, quietest lines, often the best untouched snow.

name: Higashidateyama & Terakoya
blurb: The largest connected block of runs, including Takamagahara Mammoth.

name: Yokoteyama
blurb: Easternmost, quietest, right by the pass that's shut all winter.

name: Sun Valley cluster
blurb: Sun Valley · Kidoike · Maruike · Giant — central, good beginner mix.

name: Kita-Shiga Kogen
blurb: Ryuoo & Komaruyama — a separate resort, needs its own transport leg.

name: Yudanaka & Shibu Onsen
blurb: Base Two — Kamei no Yu & Aburaya Tousen, the station, onsen town.

name: Snow Monkey Park
blurb: Jigokudani Yaen-koen — the Day 4 side trip from Yudanaka.
